name: sdCore_publicSeed
marker: /-- H0-H3 sample the actual index and seed law and alter only error flag and output
doc:
The packed core publishes its instance vectors and its actual error bit; glue.
[JLS26, SdSamp′, pp. 15-16]. This theorem compares the deterministic vector maps.

**Proof sketch.** Read the core fields, public packing equation, and publicSeed
coordinate equation. Both sides then have the same explicit sum-coordinate match.
header:
theorem sdCore_publicSeed (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ)
    (I : P.Idx' κ pp) (d : P.Draw κ pp) :
    (P.sdCore κ pp I d).seed.1 =
      P.publicSeed κ pp (fun k => ((P.sdCore κ pp I d).instances k).pub)
        (P.sdCore κ pp I d).err

name: Params.prg_verdict_prob
doc:
A shared-contract PRG realiser has the advised reduction's exact verdict probability;
reduction glue for [JLS26, Lemma 4.2, p. 19]. Only encoded challenges and layout-length
coins are used. The unused suffix is removed by the existing uniform restriction law.

**Proof sketch.** Reindex the realiser's coins through coinsEquivPoly, read its verdict,
read prgRed, and apply pushesUniform_restrict along the prefix injection together with
the existing ofFn_castLE_eq_take representation equation.
header:
theorem Params.prg_verdict_prob (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (A : NUPPT)
    (ω : ∀ N, P.PRGAdvice π N) (B : NUPPT)
    (hB : B.RealizesOn P.prgEnc (A.coins.subst .var)
      (fun N x r => P.prgRed π A N (ω N) x r)) (N : ℕ) (x : P.PRGChal N) :
    ProbComp.prob (ProbComp.sample (B.Coins N))
        (fun r => B.distinguisherL N (P.prgEnc N x) r = true) =
      ProbComp.prob (ProbComp.sample (A.Coins (P.kappaOfN N)))
        (fun r => A.distinguisherL (P.kappaOfN N)
          (P.prgPre π N (ω N) x) r = true)
overlap_scope: COMPONENT_CORE_ACTUAL_READERS_ABSTRACTED; MRr3 bitvector activation reader and actual coin restriction remain explicit in candidate

name: Params.prg_nuisance_average
doc:
The actual index/seed nuisance draws average to the explicit PRG advice law;
construction-specific averaging glue for [JLS26, Lemma 4.2, p. 19]. The Boolean index
retains G.idSamp's exact pushforward law; no uniformity of G.Idx is assumed.

**Proof sketch.** Read the concrete joint draws and idCore. Reindex the advice law
through its supplied record/product equivalence. Split the specified actual
products with expect_sample_pair, reindex their factors by an explicit proof-local
permutation with expect_sample_equiv, and discard only the unused repetition draw
with expect_const.
header:
theorem Params.prg_nuisance_average (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (N : ℕ) :
    let κ := P.kappaOfN N
    ∀ f : P.G.Idx (P.n κ) → (Fin (P.n κ) → Bool) →
      (Fin (P.m κ) → Fin (P.B κ)) →
      Matrix (Fin (P.n κ)) (Fin (P.ℓ κ)) (ZMod (π κ).p) →
      (Fin κ → Fin (P.n κ) → ZMod (π κ).p) → ℝ,
    ProbComp.expect (P.idSamp' κ (π κ)) (fun I =>
      ProbComp.expect (ProbComp.sample (P.Draw κ (π κ))) (fun d =>
        ProbComp.expect
          (ProbComp.sample (Fin κ → Fin (P.n κ) → ZMod (π κ).p))
          (fun u => f I.1 d.1 I.2.1 I.2.2 u))) =
      ProbComp.expect (ProbComp.sample (P.PRGAdvice π N)) (fun ω =>
        ProbComp.expect (P.G.idSamp (P.n κ)) (fun I =>
          ProbComp.expect (ProbComp.sample (Fin (P.n κ) → Bool))
            (fun σ => f I σ ω.buckets ω.matrix ω.uniform)))
overlap_scope: COMPONENT_CORE_ACTUAL_READERS_ABSTRACTED; actual generator index law remains the idCore pushforward, not a uniform G.Idx draw
placement_note: Preferred explicitly typed helper05; keeps qualified Params header before source namespace Params.

name: Params.prg_chain_accept_average
doc:
An all-uniform-public chain is the average of its fixed-advice PRG sections;
construction-specific semantic glue for [JLS26, Lemma 4.2, p. 19]. The equality is
of acceptance probabilities; unused queries are marginalized only in expectation.

**Proof sketch.** At an image parameter, the inverse reader identifies kappa. Read the
chain endpoint and preprocessing. Reindex the comparison vector by the explicit output
Fin equivalence, then apply prg_nuisance_average to the actual adversarial verdict test.
header:
theorem Params.prg_chain_accept_average (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (A : NUPPT)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : N = P.n (P.kappaOfN N)) (b : Bool) :
    accept (P.chainGame A b (P.kappaOfN N) (P.kappaOfN N)
        (π (P.kappaOfN N))) =
      ProbComp.expect (ProbComp.sample (P.PRGAdvice π N)) (fun ω =>
        accept ((P.G.idSamp N).bind fun I =>
          (ProbComp.sample (Fin N → Bool)).bind fun σ =>
          (ProbComp.sample (Fin (P.G.outLen N) → Bool)).bind fun v =>
          (ProbComp.sample (A.Coins (P.kappaOfN N))).bind fun r =>
            pure (A.distinguisherL (P.kappaOfN N)
              (P.prgPre π N ω (I, if b then P.G.eval N I σ else v)) r)))
overlap_scope: OUTPUT_REINDEX_COMPONENT_CORE; complete image/chain/preprocessing normalization plus nuisance averaging remain source obligations
placement_note: Helper06 retains qualified Params header; install after helper05, before original prg_hop namespace block.
